item.title: Elephant rescued from deep well in Odisha’s Keonjhar after 6-hour operation; 3 injured in aftermath
item.description: An elephant that had fallen into a deep well in Banajodi village under Sadar Block in Odisha's Keonjhar was successfully rescued after a six-hour-long operation by the Forest Department early Thursday morning. The animal had reportedly strayed into the area in search of food when it accidentally fell into the well. item.description: With the deadline for filing nominations for the Rajya Sabha elections ending on Thursday, the five candidates from Odisha are set to submit their papers later in the day. Of the four vacant seats from Odisha, the first two are expected to see straightforward outcomes, while the third and fourth seats have drawn significant political attention. item.title: U.S. attacks Iranian warship off Sri Lanka coast; 87 dead, many missing
item.description: An Iranian naval vessel was attacked by the United States off the coast of Sri Lanka on Tuesday, leaving at least 87 crew members dead and many others missing. The ship, identified as IRIS Dena, had a total of 180 personnel on board at the time of the incident. According to available reports, 30 crew members have been rescued by the Sri Lankan Navy. item.description: On the occasion of Biju Jayanti on Thursday, Shreemayee Mishra launched a sharp attack on BJD president and former Odisha Chief Minister Naveen Patnaik. item.title: Union Home Minister Amit Shah to arrive in Odisha for 2-Day visit, to attend CISF Raising Day in Cuttack
item.description: Union Home Minister Amit Shah is scheduled to arrive in Odisha on Thursday for a two-day official visit, during which he will attend a series of programmes across Cuttack, Jatani and Bhubaneswar. Shah is expected to land at Biju Patnaik International Airport at 08:00 pm and will stay in Bhubaneswar overnight. His official engagements will commence on March 6. On the morning of March 6, he will attend the Raising Day programme of the Central Industrial Security Force (CISF) at Mundali in Cuttack.
